meta.title: RepoChan — Wireframe Metamorphosis
meta.description: Protocol first, then skin. Scroll to watch a git repository rendered layer by layer from ASCII wireframe into a full brand world.

stages.title: Protocol first, then skin.
stages.body: RepoChan renders a git repository into a complete brand world. It all starts with a schema: analysis is the skeleton, the CLI is the only write path, and the agent is bring-your-own.

stages.title: Gray boxes first, fields before paint.
stages.body: A deterministic scan reads the repo's languages, dependencies, commands and tone. Before a single drop of color there are techStack, commands and readmeTone — they decide what she will grow into.

stages.title: RENDERING PERSONA…
stages.body: Interview answers are distilled into a character: silver hair, heterochromia, a triangle hair clip, big headphones around her neck. The lineart fixes pose and silhouette — she has no color yet, but she is already here.
stages.imgAlt: RepoChan character lineart: black ink on white, jumping pose

stages.title: Five flat colors, personality on stage.
stages.body: The foundation sheet compresses the whole world into a handful of hex codes: lake blue, sakura pink, purple, mint, warm yellow and ink. Every downstream stroke picks from this table — consistency is not a constraint, it is her taste.
stages.imgAlt: Flat-color stage: character being painted, foundation palette beside

stages.title: Stickers and halftones, texture grows.
stages.body: Stickers, seamless patterns and pixel stars are applied layer by layer — a language she learned from her zine and washi-tape collection. Flat color starts to gain a tactile feel.
stages.imgAlt: Texture stage: stickers and pattern around the character

stages.title: Light and shadow land, the scene focuses.
stages.body: The painter delivers in dependency order: foundation sheet first, then cutouts, then posters and scenes. Every stroke traces back to an order id — that is what the protocol is for.
stages.imgAlt: Full-render stage: Sugar Riff studio scene with the finished character

stages.title: Controls light up, the page powers on.
stages.body: Wireframe buttons become real buttons, cards gain focus states. The page grants life — the page you are looking at right now is the protocol's final state.
stages.ctaPrimary: Click me — I'm a real button
stages.imgAlt: Live stage: wireframe button turns into a clickable colored button

stages.title: The protocol grew flesh.
stages.body: From one schema to a breathing brand world: persona, foundation sheet, stickers, posters, landing pages. Hand her your repository.
stages.imgAlt: Complete brand world: full-color character, pattern and stickers

colophon.line1: RepoChan — core is pure protocol, skill grants the soul, paint grants the skin, page grants life.
colophon.line2: This page is its own evidence: schema → lineart → flat → texture → render → live.
